identificationModule.briefTitle: Savolitinib vs. Sunitinib in MET-driven PRCC.
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III, Open Label, Randomised, Controlled, Multi-Centre Study To Assess the Efficacy and Safety of Savolitinib Versus Sunitinib in Patients With MET-Driven, Unresectable and Locally Advanced, Or Metastatic Papillary Renal Cell Carcinoma (PRCC)

interventions.name: Savolitinib
interventions.description: 600 mg (400 mg if \<50 kg) by mouth (PO) with a meal once daily (QD), continuously

interventions.name: Sunitinib
interventions.description: 50 mg by mouth (PO) once daily (QD), with or w/o food, 4 weeks on/2weeks off
